basic_info.chief_complaint: Bleeding from brushing teeth has improved.

chief_complaint.chief_complaint: Bleeding from brushing teeth has improved.

oral_examination.oral_examination: Gum bleeding improved, soft calculus index (D1): 1, calculus index (Cl): 1 = supragingival calculus covers no more than 1/3 of the tooth surface,

treatment_plan.notes: Avoid acidic foods within a week and avoid hot and cold stimulation. Maintain oral hygiene and rinse with mouthwash. Regular re-examination and follow-up treatment if any discomfort occurs.

source_handle: Most of the teeth underwent subgingival scaling, alternate flushing with hydrogen peroxide and normal saline, and Palio ointment was applied to the entire mouth periodontally.
